title: Pylint 2.1.1 throws StopIteration on Python 3.7.1

labels.name: Needs reproduction :mag:
labels.description: Need a way to reproduce it locally on a maintainer's machine

labels.name: Crash 💥
labels.description: A bug that makes pylint crash

body:
### Steps to reproduce
1. docker run -it -v `pwd`:/opt/myproject python:3.7.1-slim-stretch bash -c 'pip install --pre pylint; cd /opt/myproject; pylint lib'

### Current behavior
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
```

### Expected behavior
-----------------------------------
Your code has been rated at 9.99/10


### pylint --version output
pylint 2.1.1
astroid 2.0.4
Python 3.7.1 (default, Oct 29 2018, 17:51:13)
[GCC 6.3.0 20170516]

### Suggested solution
Fix code according to https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0479/
```
diff -ru pylint-2.1.1/checkers/spelling.py pylint/checkers/spelling.py
--- pylint-2.1.1/checkers/spelling.py   2018-10-30 10:03:04.000000000 -0700 
+++ pylint/checkers/spelling.py 2018-11-01 04:08:25.665123062 -0700
@@ -114,7 +114,7 @@
     def next(self):
         while True:
             if not self._text:
-                raise StopIteration()
+                return
             if '/' not in self._text:
                 text = self._text
                 self._offset = 0
@@ -138,9 +138,9 @@
             if not pre_text or not post_text:
                 break
             if not pre_text[-1].isalpha() or not post_text[0].isalpha():
-                raise StopIteration()
+                return
             self._text = pre_text + ' ' + post_text
-        raise StopIteration()
+        return


 class SpellingChecker(BaseTokenChecker):
```
